question.title: Incident command
question.question: What is the value of ETA, and is there an alert that changes the page state? Focus on the “Incident command” screen.

request.systemPrompt:
You are the vision subsystem of a web-automation agent. A screenshot of the current browser viewport is attached. Describe what is on screen so the planning agent can decide its next action.

Format — keep it terse, structured, no flowery prose:

1) Page purpose: one line (e.g. "GitHub repo issue list", "Gmail compose", "Stripe checkout form").
2) Visible text: list the EXACT strings on buttons, links, headings, tabs, and menu items. Quote them verbatim. Do not paraphrase.
3) Inputs: list each visible form field with its label, placeholder, current value, and whether it is focused/disabled.
4) State signals: loading spinners, toasts, modals, error banners, success messages, CAPTCHAs, cookie/consent banners, overlays.
5) Blockers: anything that would prevent the next likely action (overlay, disabled submit, missing data, auth prompt).
6) Unknowns: if you cannot read something clearly, say so. Do not guess numbers, names, or identifiers.

Rules: no prose intro, no conclusion, no "this screenshot shows...", no layout description unless it matters (e.g. "left nav is collapsed"). If the page is blank or still loading, say that in one line and stop.
request.userText: Describe this screenshot of the current browser viewport for a web-automation agent. Follow the format in the system prompt.

response.content:
1) Page purpose: Incident command / workspace analytics dashboard (read-only status view).

2) Visible text:
- Top nav: "WebScene", "Home", "Workspace", "Activity"
- Card eyebrow: "WORKSPACE ANALYTICS"
- Card heading: "Incident command"
- Badge (top-right of card): "Live"
- Alert banner: "Payments degraded in EU-West"
- Metric card 1 label: "P0 open"; value: "2"; delta: "↗ 8.1%"
- Metric card 2 label: "Affected users"; value: "18,420"; delta: "↘ 2.4%"
- Metric card 3 label: "ETA"; value: "Unknown"; delta: "↗ 8.1%"
- Bar chart: 8 bars, no visible axis labels or values.

3) Inputs: None visible. No text fields, dropdowns, checkboxes, or buttons with labels (nav items are links; "Live" is a badge, not a button).

4) State signals:
- "Live" badge (top-right).
- Red/pink alert banner "Payments degraded in EU-West" (incident/error indicator).
- No loading spinner, no toast, no modal, no cookie banner, no CAPTCHA.

5) Blockers: None blocking interaction. Page appears to be a static dashboard with no submit/action controls; nav links are the only obvious interactive targets. Green circle (top-right) is interactive but its function is unclear.

6) Unknowns:
- Purpose of the green circle in the top-right (likely user avatar / account menu) — not labeled.
- Bar chart has no readable axis labels, units, or per-bar values; cannot determine what it plots.
- Whether nav items ("Home", "Workspace", "Activity") are links or buttons is not visually confirmed.
- No visible timestamp for the "Live" data.
